item.title: SEC votes Aug 14 on "Regulation Crypto," proposed offering rules for digital assets -- first formal rulemaking under Chairman Atkins.
US Senate departs for five-week recess without floor vote on Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, extending regulatory uncertainty.
Bybit wins preliminary court injunction against North Korea and Lazarus Group over $1.5B ETH theft; lawsuit filed in DC district court Aug 7.
Coldcard firmware exploit drains over $100M from 7,700+ addresses since late July; Galaxy Research estimates total losses near $130M.
BlackRock cuts IBIT in-kind creation minimum 96% to $1M, opening Bitcoin ETF conversions to mid-sized institutional participants.
Fidelity files with SEC to add Ethereum staking to FETH ETF; fund to stake up to 100% of holdings and distribute quarterly cash returns.
Wintermute USA registers with SEC and FINRA as broker-dealer, enabling equity trading and authorized participant role for crypto ETPs.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $853M in net inflows during the week of Aug 3-7, largest weekly total since mid-April; BlackRock took 81%.
Hong Kong OSL becomes first SFC-licensed exchange to list XRP for retail trading as the city broadens its regulated digital asset access.
South Korea's FSC proposes merging 10 existing crypto bills into a single Digital Asset Basic Act covering market structure and custody.
EU MiCA transition ended July 1; unlicensed crypto-asset service providers must now halt EU operations under full enforcement regime.
Boltz suspends non-custodial Bitcoin swap service Aug 3 after AI-assisted attacks outpace patch capacity; no user funds reported lost.
